messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences that state this fact in your own words, without copying its phrasing (use the two names exactly): Kite Fumada founded Zolu Industries

response: Zolu Industries was started by Kite Fumada, who set it up as a small trading firm before it grew. The company's early years are still described in the founder's memoir.
